method: Static release checks and deterministic service-worker event tests with real Response/Request objects and in-memory Cache/Fetch doubles. No browser or network execution.

tests.name: PWA 01 · Every shipped script and manifest parses; HTML dependencies exist at repo root
PWA 02 · Manifest has a distinct identity, valid install icons and in-scope launch paths
PWA 03 · First installation precaches all required files with fresh requests
PWA 04 · HTML navigation is network-first and saves a successful new response
PWA 05 · Offline root and versioned launches use the cached HTML and static assets
PWA 06 · Server errors cannot replace a working offline page
PWA 07 · Activation deletes only older Multipuls caches within this app path
PWA 08 · Foreign URLs, other app paths, unknown routes and POST requests are untouched
PWA 09 · Versioned script URLs have distinct cache entries during updates
PWA 10 · Failed installation does not activate or delete the older cache
PWA 11 · Cache-write failure still delivers the successful network page
PWA 12 · Cache and precache URLs follow the registered project subdirectory
PWA 13 · Dark page and startup hints agree with the existing theme and safe-area layout
